description: Triage up to 1,000 backtests in one call: the best-of-N multiple-testing selection correction over every return series — $0.01 per series, survivors ranked best-first. Use when your agent has a FARM of backtests, strategies, or research results — dozens to a thousand — and needs triage, not one-by-one verdicts. One call runs the selection correction over every series: each gets NO (killed), PROVISIONAL (survived this gate), or ERROR (malformed). Results ranked sur PAID: $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Call it to receive the payment challenge.
